title: Flexible water connectors.
officialText: Flexible water connectors exposed to continuous pressure shall conform to IAPMO PS74 and PS 48, shall not exceed 24 inches (610mm), shall be used in exposed locations only and shall be used singularly; that is, two connectors cannot be joined.
